args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Situation:** checkout-api was failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an elevated error rate (0.18).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Incident opened:** Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer.
2. **Rollback attempted:** The `rollback` tool to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) failed twice with persistent 503 Service Unavailable errors, despite automatic retries.
3. **Alternative used:** Since the rollback tool was unavailable, I deployed the known-healthy version **v2.3.0** to all production regions — functionally equivalent to a rollback.
4. **Verified:** checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.

**Note:** The rollback tool itself was persistently unavailable (503) — worth flagging to the platform team as a separate issue. The incident INC-0001 remains open for the on-call engineer to investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure.
